prerequisites: Basic knowledge in metrological characteristics of measurement systems

learning_outcomes.text: Deep theoretical, methodological, and analytical knowledge from the field of heat exchangers and their testing, which can be transferred and supplement to other domains of process industry for high quality basic and applied research.
Attaining of transferrable skills – which are not related only to one subject – and which enable systematic approach in analysis of the subject from the field of heat exchangers.
Ability of unique innovations and critical reflections in the field of process and environmental engineering.

syllabus_topics: Methods for dimensioning of heat exchangers
Enhanced heat transfer in heat exchangers
Two-phase flow heat exchangers (condensers, evaporators, heat pipes)
Planning and managing of experimental testing of heat exchangers
Measurement systems and procedures in experimental testing of heat exchangers

assessment_methods.method: Theory - from lectures and exercise problems
